hev_suit.name: HEV suit
hev_suit.description: The Mark IV Hazardous Environment suit: radiation shielding, a power-armour layer charged by batteries, an injector system and a voice that announces every misfortune in a soothing female tone.

do: You're already wearing it.

do.say: You climb into the HEV suit. A calm synthetic voice runs through its start-up checks: power armour, atmospheric contaminant sensors, vital sign monitoring, munition level monitoring, communications. All systems nominal. Have a very safe day.

pcv.name: Powered Combat Vest
pcv.description: The HECU's Powered Combat Vest: kevlar plates with a battery-charged armour layer.

do: You're already wearing it.
You strap on the PCV. Its charge indicator glows.

security_vest.name: security vest
security_vest.description: A Black Mesa security kevlar vest. Not an HEV suit, but it stops a 9mm round.

security_helmet.name: security helmet
security_helmet.description: A Black Mesa security helmet with a dark visor.

medkit.name: first aid kit

props.taste: You tear open the kit and patch yourself up.

medkit.description: A white first aid kit with a red cross. Bandages, a stimulant shot, the usual.

battery.name: suit battery
battery.description: A Black Mesa suit battery. Snap it into a suit's charging port.

do: You snap the battery into your suit. (Suit {player.suit})

ammo_box.name: #ammo_kind#
ammo_box.description: Ammunition. In this place, you can never have enough.

use: You top up your magazines. It's reassuring to hear them click home.

long_jump.name: long jump module
long_jump.description: An experimental HEV attachment that fires a short thrust for enormous leaps. Crouch, then jump.

do: It's already fitted.

do.say: You clip the long jump module to the back of your suit. It hums.

night_vision.name: night vision goggles
night_vision.description: HECU night vision goggles, which turn the dark a ghostly green.

bm_keycard.name: #bm_card_colour# security keycard
bm_keycard.description: A Black Mesa keycard on a clip. A security clearance stripe runs along the edge.

blowtorch.name: engineer's blowtorch
blowtorch.description: A HECU combat engineer's cutting torch. It goes through welded doors like they owe it money.

radio.name: field radio
radio.description: A military field radio, tuned to a HECU frequency.

health_charger.name: health charger

appearance.text: A wall-mounted health charger glows a steady green.
A health charger on the wall has gone dark, its reservoir empty.

health_charger.description: A Black Mesa medical station. Press your palm to it and it injects morphine and a coagulant cocktail.

do: The charger buzzes. Empty.
You're in no need of it.
The charger hums and stings. (Health {player.health})

suit_charger.name: HEV charger

appearance.text: An HEV charging station hums on the wall, its readout glowing orange.
An HEV charging station on the wall is drained and silent.

suit_charger.description: A wall unit that recharges a suit's power armour.

do: The charger whines. Drained.
Your suit is already fully charged.
Power crackles into your suit. (Suit {player.suit})

supply_crate.name: #crate_kind#

appearance.text: A smashed crate lies in pieces.
A wooden supply crate is stacked here.

supply_crate.description: A wooden crate stencilled with Black Mesa inventory codes.

do: It's already been smashed open.
You lever the lid off. Inside: {self.contents}.
It's nailed shut, so you stamp on the lid until the planks give. Inside: {self.contents}.
There's nothing left to break.
The crate splinters apart. Inside: {self.contents}.
You crack the crate open with {target}. Inside: {self.contents}.

vending_machine.name: soda machine
vending_machine.appearance: A soda machine hums against the wall.
vending_machine.description: It sells cans of something brightly coloured. The fizzy kind of pick-me-up.

do: A can thunks into the tray.
You give it a whack. A can rattles out.

push: It rocks, but holds its ground.

props.taste: Sweet, flat, and somehow exactly what you needed.

bm_terminal.name: computer terminal
bm_terminal.appearance: A beige computer terminal flickers on a desk.
bm_terminal.description: A Black Mesa workstation, its green text scrolling.

hecu_logbook.name: field logbook
hecu_logbook.description: A HECU field logbook in a waterproof cover.

xen_glyph.name: alien glyph
xen_glyph.appearance: Strange glowing glyphs are etched into the rock.
xen_glyph.description: They pulse slowly. Looking at them for too long makes your teeth ache.

dead_scientist.name: dead scientist
dead_scientist.appearance: A scientist lies dead here, lab coat stained dark.

take: You leave the dead in peace.

dead_guard.name: dead security guard
dead_guard.appearance: A security guard lies slumped against the wall, his helmet askew.

take: You leave the dead in peace.

dead_marine.name: dead marine
dead_marine.appearance: A HECU marine lies face-down here in his gas mask.
dead_marine.description: His webbing is still full of gear.

take: You leave the dead in peace.

cockroach.name: cockroach
cockroach.appearance: A cockroach scuttles along the skirting board.

do: You step on it with a satisfying crunch.

xen_light.name: xen light stalk
xen_light.appearance: A glowing light-stalk sways here, retracting shyly when you come near.
xen_light.description: A bioluminescent stalk with a bulb that pulls back into the ground at the slightest disturbance.

healing_pool.name: healing pool
healing_pool.appearance: A shallow pool of glowing water ripples here.
healing_pool.description: The water is warm and faintly luminous. Wounds close where it touches them.

do: You wade into the glowing pool. Your wounds knit closed. (Health {player.health})
You drink the glowing water. Strength floods back. (Health {player.health})

barnacle.name: barnacle

props.attack_text: snags you with its tongue and reels
props.death_text: The barnacle shudders and lets go, spitting out a ribcage and something shiny.

barnacle.appearance: A barnacle clings to the ceiling here, its long sticky tongue dangling to the floor.
barnacle.description: A ceiling-dwelling Xen predator. It hauls up whatever touches its tongue and chews.

scientist.name: Dr. #bm_surname#
scientist.appearance: {self.Name}, a Black Mesa scientist in a white lab coat, is here.
scientist.description: Lab coat, ID badge, glasses, and the expression of someone whose theories are being tested in the worst possible way.

profile.motive_text: get out of here alive, and maybe write a paper about it
goals: find out what went wrong with the test
greet: The scientist peers at you over his glasses. "Oh! I thought you were... never mind."
profile.epilogue: {speaker.The} survives, somehow, and never takes another job underground.

do: "#scientist_chatter#"

security_guard.name: Officer #bm_surname#
security_guard.appearance: {self.Name}, a Black Mesa security guard, stands here in his blue shirt and kevlar vest.
security_guard.description: Blue shirt, kevlar vest, helmet pushed back, 9mm on his hip. Every guard here looks a bit alike.

profile.motive_text: get everybody out who can still walk
goals: get the scientists to the surface
have a beer once this is over
profile.backstory: "Security. I check badges, unlock doors and get yelled at by scientists. Today I'm getting shot at too."
profile.epilogue: {speaker.The} makes it out, and swears the first round's on him.

do: "#guard_chatter#"

gman.name: G-Man
gman.appearance: A thin man in a blue suit, briefcase in hand, watches you from a little too far away.
gman.description: Pale, gaunt, immaculate. He speaks in strange pauses and stresses the wrong syllables. Nobody on the staff list matches him.

profile.motive_text: see that certain events unfold... according to plan
profile.backstory: He smiles thinly. "Who I am is... not important. What matters is what you do... next."
greet: The man in the suit straightens his tie and regards you with interest.

do: He adjusts his tie, looks at you a moment too long, and says nothing at all.

attack: Your aim slides off him as though he were somewhere else entirely.

hecu_ally.name: #hecu_rank# #hecu_surname#
hecu_ally.appearance: {self.Name}, a HECU marine of your unit, covers the corners with his rifle.
hecu_ally.description: Gas mask, fatigues, MP5. He nods at you: one of yours.

profile.motive_text: complete the mission and get back to the extraction point
goals: get out on the last Osprey
find the rest of the squad
profile.backstory: "Same as you, Corporal. Dropped into this mess and told to clean it up."
profile.epilogue: {speaker.The} makes it home. He never talks about Black Mesa, not once.

do: "#hecu_chatter#"

hecu_medic.name: Medic #hecu_surname#
hecu_medic.appearance: {self.Name}, a HECU field medic with a white helmet cross, checks his kit here.
hecu_medic.description: A combat medic, satchel full of morphine and patience.

do: "Hold still, Corporal." The medic patches you up with a needle and a field dressing. (Health {player.health})
"You're good, Corporal. Try to stay that way."

hecu_engineer.name: Engineer #hecu_surname#
hecu_engineer.appearance: {self.Name}, a HECU combat engineer, has a cutting torch slung on his back.
hecu_engineer.description: A combat engineer with a welding mask pushed up on his helmet.

do: "Doors giving you grief? Here. Bring it back in one piece." He hands you his cutting torch.
"Cut through anything, that torch. Even regulations."
